paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The figure illustrates the first token attention scores of the baseline across various layers. The X-axis is labeled 'layer' and is linear with a range from 0 to 22. The Y-axis is labeled 'first token attention score', also linear, with a range from 0.0 to 1.0. The graph features a single blue line representing the first token attention score, which fluctuates across the layers, showing notable peaks and troughs. The line begins at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, reaches a high of about 0.9 around layer 5, and then drops to around 0.4 before experiencing further fluctuations, stabilizing near 0.6 towards the end at layer 22. A dashed green line indicates the mean score of 0.467, visually indicating that several points fall below this mean value.
model_annotations.Chinese: The plot illustrates the first token attention scores of a baseline model across twenty-three layers. The x-axis, labeled 'layer', has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22 with evenly spaced integer values. The y-axis, labeled 'first token attention score', also employs a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, depicting attention scores as a continuous variable. A single line represents the 'first token attention score', colored in blue with a solid line style, showing fluctuations across layers with notable peaks at layers 5 and 22 where the scores reach about 0.9 and 0.8 respectively, along with a significant dip between layers 4 and 6. A dashed green line indicates the mean score of 0.467, providing a reference point for evaluating the attention scores across different layers.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the first token attention scores of a baseline model across different layers. The x-axis is labeled 'layer' and operates on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22. The y-axis is labeled 'first token attention score,' also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1. A blue solid line represents the first token attention score, starting at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, increasing sharply to a peak of around 0.9 at layer 5, before fluctuating through the subsequent layers up to 22, where it finishes near 0.8. A horizontal dashed green line shows the mean attention score, which is 0.467, providing a reference point for the scores.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die ersten Token-Attentionscores des Baseline-Modells in Abhängigkeit von der Schichtnummer. Die x-Achse ist mit 'layer' beschriftet und hat einen linearen Skalierungsbereich von 0 bis 23. Die y-Achse ist als 'first token attention score' gekennzeichnet, ebenfalls mit einer linearen Skala, die Werte von 0.0 bis 1.0 abdeckt. Die Linie im Diagramm ist blau, durchgezogen und zeigt eine zunehmende Variation der Werte. Sie beginnt bei etwa 0.3 in der Null- bis Fünfschicht und steigt dann sprunghaft auf etwa 0.8 in der Fünften Schicht, bevor sie zu einem Höchstwert von ca. 0.8 in der 21. Schicht erreicht. Der Diagramm enthält eine gestrichelte, grüne Linie, die den Durchschnitt von 0.467 markiert, wobei die Werte einige Male darüber und darunter schwanken, insbesondere mit einem Abfall in der 23. Schicht.
